scenes.text: There is a star that should have burned out four billion years ago.
scenes.art_prompt: a single small blue-white star alone in a vast dark field of stars, cinematic

scenes.text: It is too small, too old, and far too quiet to still be burning.
scenes.art_prompt: a cutaway of a star's core, thin fuel layers glowing faintly, physics illustration

scenes.text: Astronomers watched it for decades. It never dimmed, not once.
scenes.art_prompt: a telescope dome under a night sky with one unusually steady bright star

scenes.text: Then they found a second light beside it - too faint to see on its own.
scenes.art_prompt: two stars locked in a close orbit, one bright, one pale, exchanging glowing streams

scenes.text:
It was never one star.
It is a pair, quietly feeding each other, refusing to go out.
scenes.art_prompt: two entwined stars glowing together in deep space, calm and resolved
a wide field of stars with one warm double point of light, final wide shot
